card.name: Start of Rim/Rem names and words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word beginning Rim-, Rem- or Reim-, split before the rest. It appears in names such as Rimini, Remus, rimantadine, rimegepant, remifentanil, Rembrandt and Remembrance.
